[[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] '''Nalju''' was the head of [[House Nalju/Legends|House Nalju]]. He was a staunch supporter of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and a friend of [[Tarsus Valorum/Legends|Tarsus Valorum]]. He was outraged on the [[Kidnap attempt on Serenno|kidnapping attempt]] on Tarsus Valorum.
